required_outcomes: Launching once preserves one Agent Session identity across all surface transitions.
Exactly one Surface Attachment has a Lease Holder plan whenever the lease is held.
Concurrent non-holders receive Observer plans and cannot send live input or interactive mouse events.
Hide, close, detach, release, and explicit switch relinquish live authority immediately.
Expiry recovers from a stale holder and promotes a pending requester without restarting the agent.
The Agent Session can produce output and complete with no Surface Attachments.
Reopening after background completion projects the same transcript revision and session identity.
Only accepted Lease Holder input and agent output advance the canonical transcript revision.
A second pending transfer request is rejected without changing authority.
Pi and Codex use identical lease semantics despite different session identity shapes.

fixture_boundary.agent_processes: modeled identities and transcript events; no real Pi or Codex process is launched
fixture_boundary.capability_plans: role and live-authority projection from the frozen V2 contract

out_of_scope: real Pi or Codex runtime attachment
